name: Vermona Mono Lancet '15
description: Vermona Mono Lancet '15 analog synthesizer: the seven MIDI switches its user guide gives control changes, each with its factory setting.

sources.title: User Guide Mono Lancet '15

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/vermona/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/vermona/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a control change the guide gives, sent on the channel variable: the instrument receives on channel 1 until it is powered on with TRIG held and sent a note, whose channel it stores. Each is a switch, "0..63 means OFF; 64..127 means ON" for every one, as the guide says; a factory reset puts them back. The guide gives no controller for the sound's own knobs. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

coverage.inboundControllers: none: the instrument has MIDI IN and MIDI THRU only

parameters.name: Pitch Bender
parameters.description: CC 84: You can change the pitch of both oscillators within a range of ± 5 semi-tones by using the Pitch Bender of your keyboard. You can switch on/off this function for both oscillators using this control change message. Factory setting: ON.

parameters.name: Modulation Wheel
parameters.description: CC 85: The pulse-width of both oscillators’ square wave can be adjusted using the modulation wheel. This is an effective way of sound shaping. You can switch on/off this function for both oscillators using this control change message Factory setting: ON.

parameters.name: Aftertouch
parameters.description: CC 86: The filter’s cutoff frequency responds to MIDI aftertouch messages send by your MIDI source. If you hold a keyboard note and press it further, the aftertouch signal will open the filter. Factory setting: ON.

parameters.name: Velocity
parameters.description: CC 87: Mono Lancet ’15 can respond to MIDI velocity, which is send by almost every master keyboard. If turned on, the VCA’s output - the volume of your sound - is controlled by velocity allowing you to play the synthesizer dynamically. This works only with the VCA’s MODE switch 1^ set to EG. Factory setting: OFF.

parameters.name: Filter Velocity
parameters.description: CC 88: In addition to the VCA, velocity data can modulate the filter’s cutoff frequency. This function works only if the EG INT controller 1# is not in it’s center position and CC 87 is ON. Factory setting: OFF.

parameters.name: Auto-Glide
parameters.description: CC 89: As a factory default, the glide effect is always active (if the GLIDE control o is not set fully left). Turning GLIDE o clockwise will reveal this effect. With activated Auto-Glide the glide-effect is only present if two adjacent notes are played legato. Factory setting: OFF.

parameters.name: Legato
parameters.description: CC 90: By factory default the envelope generator is triggered with every incoming note-on command, wether it is played staccato or legato. With activated Legato mode, the envelop will only be triggered when playing legato. Factory setting: OFF.
